name: Animated FB Showcase Reel
description: A single animated 1:1 square silent motion piece for Facebook / Meta / IG feed - a self-promo showcase reel for a tool that produces visual outputs, built entirely in HyperFrames as ONE opacity-gated GSAP timeline (no sub-compositions). Five beats over ~30s: HOOK (mascot + eyebrow + tagline), SHOWCASE WALL (a tiled grid of muted pre-rendered output clips proving range), FEATURED (one hero clip + the one-prompt claim), STACK (a scrolling marquee of integration logo SVGs - plugs into your stack), CTA (mascot + wordmark + URL + button). The discipline: reuse the tool's OWN already-rendered outputs as the proof wall (zero new model spend), drive all video layers MUTED (FB feed auto-mutes - silent by design), gate every beat by opacity on a single timeline registered on window.__timelines, and use a TIME_SCALE wrapper to stretch a 15s authored storyboard to a 30s render without rewriting tween positions. Brand fonts + a single accent + a corner stamp keep it on-brand with no AI media generation.
referenceNotes: No AI-gen refs needed. The proof wall is the tool's OWN already-rendered output clips (reused muted, $0 new spend). Bring brand fonts (woff2), a single accent hex, the mascot/wordmark, and integration logo SVGs.

slots.description: The hook + claim lines (e.g. 'ONE PROMPT.' / 'PRODUCTION READY.').
Single brand accent hex. One hue; never neon-glow per brand rules.
Local woff2 brand fonts (display/mono) dropped into assets/.
The tool's OWN pre-rendered output clips (muted, -noaudio.mp4) tiled in the showcase wall. ~9-13.
The single hero clip for the FEATURED beat.
Integration / model logo SVGs for the 'plugs into your stack' marquee.
Wordmark + URL + button text for the CTA beat.
Total duration, 15-30s (TIME_SCALE stretches a 15s storyboard to 30s).

doNotCopyLiterally: Reuse the tool's OWN already-rendered outputs as the proof wall - do not generate new media ($0). One composition, opacity-gated beats only (no data-composition-src sub-comps). Drive every video layer MUTED - silent by design, FB feed auto-mutes. Register one paused GSAP timeline on window.__timelines; use the TIME_SCALE wrapper to stretch authored positions, not a rewrite. Snapshot every beat at its hero frame BEFORE rendering. No box-shadow / neon glow per brand rules.
stackSummary: No model calls. HyperFrames single composition (opacity-gated beats, GSAP timeline on window.__timelines, muted <video> layers, TIME_SCALE wrapper), brand woff2 fonts + integration SVGs supplied, ralphy render for the 1080x1080 silent mp4. $0 total - the proof wall reuses the tool's own renders.
